notes: Routed v2 abstain_p AUC: dev 0.813, dev200 0.853, pooled 0.821 (45 unanswerable / 606 answerable). No single threshold reaches the enable bar (precision >= 0.7 at recall >= 0.4): pooled >= 0.8 flags 9 TP / 22 FP. Per route: ssu AUC 0.884 but only 1 TP at >= 0.6; multi 0.795 (2 TP / 0 FP at >= 0.6, recall 0.10); temporal 0.825 with 21 answerable packs at >= 0.8. Real Reactor (first 23 v1 test answers): 3 INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: 'my dog's name' (no own dog in the history: likely correct), 'current job title' (answerable, pack lacked the promotion sentence: fixed in v2 by ku a_r3 r3w), 'my neighborhood in Lisbon' (answerable: 'I live in Graça' was never retrieved; the ownership hint is not the cause, the pack had no neighbourhood statement). Reactor already abstains on its own when the pack lacks the fact, so a generic abstention hint would mostly add false abstentions. Keep: factual 'not found' notes from lenses only. Re-enable rule unchanged: a soft hint per route only at precision >= 0.7, recall >= 0.4 pooled; never temporal.
enable_rule: Re-enable a soft hint (hint_text_if_enabled, never a forced abstention) for a route only when its abstain_p reaches precision >= 0.7 at recall >= 0.4 on dev+dev200 pooled. Never on the temporal route (21 answerable packs at abstain_p >= 0.8).
hint_text_if_enabled: If none of the passages states this about me, say that our conversations do not contain it.
